_comment: Per-model pricing, USD per MILLION tokens, from Anthropic's published list prices (Claude API reference, checked 2026-10-06). Keys are VERSION-SPECIFIC on purpose: within a major version the tier can change (Opus 5 is $5/$25 but Opus 5.5 is $4/$20; Opus 4.5-4.8 are $5/$25 but Opus 4.0/4.1 are $15/$75), so no coarse 'claude-<family>-<major>-x' keys are defined. A session's model id is matched most-specific-first: exact id, then date-stripped version (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 -> claude-haiku-4-5), then a 'claude-<family>-<major>-x' key only if you add one. Unpriced models are warned about (top of summary.md when they carry >5% of tokens) and left at $0.00 — never priced as another model. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5m) and 2x input (1h). Cache READ multipliers differ by model: 0.025x for Fable/Mythos 5.1, 0.05x for Opus 5.5, 0.1x for the rest — always copy the read rate from the price list, don't derive it. Optional 'long_context' block: a request whose prompt (input + cache_read + cache_write tokens) exceeds threshold_tokens is billed at that block's rates for ALL its tokens (extract.py splits tokens per request). Not modelled: Opus 5.5 fast mode ($8/$40, 2x) unless the transcript records speed (it currently doesn't), batch discounts, data-residency surcharges, and the older Sonnet >200K-context tier. Verify against your own plan.
